title: Epic Games reportedly pivoting to "AI first" game development model
script:
Epic Games just banned hand-written code for Disney.
Your next Star Wars game's being built by bots.
CEO Tim Sweeney is pivoting the project to an AI-first model.
This mandate specifically targets the delayed Marvel and Star Wars shooter.
Disney backed the partnership with a one point five billion dollar investment.
Artists are now barred from delivering any AI-free concept art.
The radical shift at the Cary headquarters has already pushed back the release.
Can AI build a better shooter than human programmers?
